M-VALUES.contract: Omitted/undefined optional arguments apply only the listed default; required undefined rejects. null is explicit absence only in the union; never coalesce false, 0 or empty string. Model getters/mutations are sync. Strings/booleans are strict; numbers finite and integer where counts/IDs require. No coercion.
cases: Unset, null, false, zero, empty, undefined, wrong type; invalid assignment leaves bytes/model unchanged.

Font flags boolean|null; underline true/false/typed enum/null. Defined-style flags read false when reset, latent overrides read null. Core strings max 255 Unicode code points; astral characters count once.

M-KEYWORDS.contract: Source positional order and names retained; omit earlier optional parameter with undefined. Every source keyword-only group maps to one trailing typed options object with source-spelled keys; no source keyword-only parameters were found in this pin. No blanket named overload. Context/operation options are camelCase. Reserved TS binding package maps to owner_package, an argument binding change only.
M-KEYWORDS.example: model_method(positional: string, options?: { source_flag?: boolean }): void; illustrative rule, not an invented API.
cases: Compile retained spelling; reject camelCase model aliases, unknown option fields and ambiguous argument guessing.

M-SEQUENCE.contract: Zero-based readonly numeric lookup and at(index); negative at adds length; out of range throws BoundsError. Only Sections, _Rows and RGBColor expose source slicing: normalize/clamp endpoints, exclusive end, negatives from length, no mutation. Collections iterate in source order and length is live. Snapshot list/tuple returns are readonly arrays of live handles. SDK ordinal differs from one-based CLI.
cases: Three items: [0], at(-1), at(-4), at(3); empty collection; fractional/NaN index rejects.
slice(-2,3), slice(2,1), oversized bounds; Columns/InlineShapes/TabStops must not acquire slice by accident.
Merged cells alias; omitted cells absent; mutations invalidate removed handles; no wrapper allocation identity requirement.

M-KEYS.contract: Styles/LatentStyles at(string) retains source keyed lookup; no numeric index. Styles ID fallback remains deprecated and warns, get_by_id/default preserve documented fallback. Comments.get(comment_id) is nullable ID lookup. Relationships at(rId) throws, get(rId, default_value?) returns null/default; retain items spelling. Owner-scoped rIds never resolve globally.
cases: Missing style throws MissingKeyError; dangling style reference uses default; misspelled assignment fails.
Comment IDs [2,8] lookup 8 succeeds, ordinal 1 does not select 8.
Relationship null/default/throw distinctions, insertion order, pop last entry, duplicate owner conflict, atomic update.

M-UNITS.contract: Immutable Length/Emu/Inches/Cm/Mm/Pt/Twips; integer EMU storage <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER in magnitude. Factors per unit: 914400/in, 360000/cm, 36000/mm, 12700/pt, 635/twip. Finite conversion rounded once nearest, halfway away from zero; check safe range before/after. Twips accessor uses same rounding. Negative allowed only where property permits. No DOCX centipoint helper. Line spacing number means multiple, Length means exact distance.
cases: Inches(1).emu=914400, Pt(1).emu=12700, Twips(1).emu=635; +/- half ties; unsafe, fractional integer constructor, NaN and Infinity reject.
Negative indent accepted, negative image dimension rejected; explicit zero never becomes omitted default.

M-ENUM.contract: Immutable nominal enum symbols with stable number/name and optional xml_value; aliases share canonical identity. fromValue validates, members includes aliases, iterator emits canonical declaration order. from_xml/to_xml retain spellings; UNMAPPED fails. No dynamic enum construction or unvalidated bare-number substitution.
cases: Assert every row numeric/XML value and alias identity; unknown names/numbers reject; setter-specific allowed subset is separate from enum membership.

M-COLOR.contract: RGBColor immutable three integer channels 0..255; from_string exactly six ASCII hex digits, case-insensitive; toString six uppercase hex digits; reject whitespace/sign/prefix/nonhex/wrong length. RGB assignment clears theme; theme assignment may preserve compatibility RGB; type reports active color category.
cases: RGBColor(10,32,255) -> 0A20FF; reject -1/256/0.5; parse lowercase and reject seven digits; null differs from AUTO/theme.

M-BYTES.contract: Input Uint8Array copied before first asynchronous suspension; every yielded source chunk copied before next pull; reject SharedArrayBuffer-backed/racy or detached inputs. Output byte getters return fresh copies; no retained caller mutation races. Byte budgets include retained copies.
cases: Mutate caller bytes immediately after factory call; reuse source chunk; mutate blob getter result; none changes admitted state.
Over-limit copied bytes reject, cancelled source settles cleanup.

M-DATES.contract: Date denotes UTC instant; clone on get/set/context admission, reject Invalid Date. Serialize whole seconds by dropping fractional second after UTC normalization, including pre-epoch timestamps. Missing/invalid source dates read null with validation diagnostics. No timezone guess, ambient Date.now or local-clock formatting.
cases: Explicit offset instant normalizes to Z, .999 discarded, pre-epoch fractional value handled; invalid assigned Date rejects before mutation; returned Date mutation inert.

M-IO.contract: Input = Uint8Array | ByteSource | VfsPath; Document(input?: Input | null, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<DocumentModel>. Null/omission uses original template. save(output: ByteSink | VfsPath): Promise<void>. All input admission always async including image/part byte loads; model getters and admitted metadata stay sync. ByteSource.open(signal?) supplies AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>; ByteSink stages/commits/aborts owned output. Path requires explicit scoped VFS; no ambient host I/O/native runtime/network. Standalone Image.from_blob(blob: Uint8Array, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<Image> and Image.from_file(image_descriptor: Input, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<Image> use explicit context; package open also takes context. Omitted context uses intrinsic documented limits and grants no ambient capabilities.
cases: For bytes/stream/path verify actual Promise; property access returns value. Reject raw path strings and text streams.
Injected VFS permission/alias/force/in-place conflict, malformed package, source/sink failure, cancellation, atomic publication and input preservation.

M-CONTEXT.contract: DocumentContext = { vfs?: VfsCapability; limits?: Readonly<LimitOptions>; signal?: AbortSignal; timestamp?: Date; author?: string; fonts?: FontMetricsCapability; template?: Uint8Array }. No environment, implicit host clock/author/fonts. Creation/comments requiring timestamp reject if absent; context supplied author used only for operations explicitly choosing context author, source author default remains empty string. Font metrics capability returns admitted deterministic metrics, never discovers/loads host fonts. Template is original admitted bytes; empty context grants no I/O.
cases: Supply fixed timestamp/author/template/metrics; repeat produces same semantic package; missing required capability rejects.
Document() stays syntactically valid async factory; creation requiring timestamp fails without supplied context rather than reading clock.

M-OWNERSHIP.contract: Live models share document owner/revision, not wrapper identity. Snapshot sequences contain live handles. Deleted/replaced subtrees invalidate handles deterministically. Cross-owner assignment rejects without explicit import. TabStop.position preserves tab handle, refreshes element, invalidates detached old node. Read-only CLI queries must not call creating getters.
cases: Unlink/relink header, delete style, clear runs, merge cells, replace tab node; assert exactly which handles remain valid.
Read CLI inspect before/after yields unchanged package hash even if equivalent model getter creates a part.

M-VIEWS.contract: Bounded XmlElementView/PartView/PackageView/RelationshipView carry owner and capability; namespace/tag, text/tail, attributes, ordered typed nodes, bytes and scoped relationships only. Validated mutations reject required-node/reference/namespace/security violations and publication validates graph. No arbitrary XPath/eval/prototype lookup, raw dependency XML object, host paths, user marshal callbacks or external target dereference. Source load/new/constructors use admitted bytes/views and fixed validation. Unsupported native/private behavior is not silently offered.
cases: External URI stays data with zero reads; reject DTD/entities/traversal, stale/foreign handle and malformed relationship graph.
Create/remove relationship preserves shared targets; lifecycle preparation occurs at admission/save with no callback execution.

M-IMAGES.contract: PNG, JPEG JFIF/Exif, GIF87a/89a, BMP, little/big endian TIFF characterized with bounded pure JS parsing; original tiny fixtures. Native width uses horizontal DPI, height vertical DPI; missing axis DPI falls back 72. One specified dimension preserves aspect, two set both. Numeric raw dimensions are integer EMUs. No host decoding/fonts/network. sha1 is compatibility metadata, not identity/security hash; SHA-256 is evidence identity.
cases: Different horizontal/vertical DPI, absent DPI, one/two/no dimensions, malformed/truncated metadata, unsupported format, oversized pixel dimensions and limits.
Embedded predicate requires admitted embedded relation; linked-only image rejects .image without fetching.

M-ERRORS.contract: Neutral classes with stable code, bounded sanitized message and structured context. Direct source raises are local evidence, not exhaustive error set; model validation, callees and admission add the referenced categories. Missing nullable lookup remains null. Do not swallow errors or leak source/project identity.
cases: Wrong type -> InputTypeError extends TypeError; bad value -> InvalidValueError extends RangeError; bounds -> BoundsError extends RangeError; missing key -> MissingKeyError extends Error; semantic validation -> SemanticValidationError.
Check read/write failure atomicity and shared CLI exit translation; diff differences are successful data.

M-CLI.contract: C-CLI governs all rows; direct common commands plus closed typed batch entries for advanced behavior. Source-spelled model fields retained; batch operation arguments use mechanical camelCase. Type/value discovery through schema/capabilities; never arbitrary method invocation.
cases: Reject singular image/table/metadata and top-level replace. Same versioned schema validates CLI JSON and SDK operation options.

additional_decisions: Relationships.get retains source spelling and nullable/default semantics; keyed at replaces throwing __getitem__, items retains source spelling. Earlier getOrNull/entries aliases are superseded.
No source keyword-only group exists in this pin; trailing typed source-spelled options rule remains mandatory for later discovered members.
LatentStyles.default_priority/load_count permit null reads/reset; next_paragraph_style setter permits null while getter returns self fallback.
docx.md §9 allowMissing wording conflicts with common allowEmpty; office-cli.md is authoritative: use allowEmpty, do not expose alias.
